comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, wages-and-r1099-single (a code-7 pension of 10,000, 1,000 withheld) with Form 1099-R box 8 (Other — the amount and its percentage) and box 9a (Your percentage of total distribution) entered at zero: the boxes are sent verbatim and a zero computes unchanged — the parent's figures, line 24 = 4,865.00. Any other entry in those boxes is the dictionary's own knockout, served by name.
